claim: At revision fc186507e5b7124f4664aa6035f25cfd3112367d, the README's documented `npm install` then `npx tsc --noEmit` exits 2 with three type errors (chartLoader.ts:210, html/htmlDocument.ts:92, workbook.ts:482) under TypeScript 5.9.3.
suggested_issue_title: The documented type-check `npx tsc --noEmit` reports 3 type errors in chartLoader.ts, htmlDocument.ts and workbook.ts
suggested_issue_body:
repository-presenter's validation pipeline (BC-02) recorded this while re-verifying `aspose-cells-foss/Aspose.Cells-FOSS-for-TypeScript`; it was then reproduced independently against the live default-branch head `fc186507e5b7124f4664aa6035f25cfd3112367d` on 2026-10-09T21:30Z.

## Summary

`package.json` defines no build script; the README (lines 329-334) documents `npm install` and `npx tsc --noEmit`. On a clean clone that command fails with three errors, all in repository sources.

## Environment

- Revision `fc186507e5b7124f4664aa6035f25cfd3112367d` (default branch `master`)
- Docker `node:22` (Node v22.23.3, npm 10.9.9), typescript 5.9.3, @types/node 25.9.9, adm-zip 0.5.18 (no lockfile is committed, so dependency resolution may differ over time)

## Steps to reproduce

```sh
git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/aspose-cells-foss/Aspose.Cells-FOSS-for-TypeScript
cd Aspose.Cells-FOSS-for-TypeScript
npm install
npx tsc --noEmit
```

## Actual result

```
aspose_cells/chartLoader.ts(210,11): error TS2345: Argument of type 'string | null' is not assignable to parameter of type 'string | undefined'.
aspose_cells/html/htmlDocument.ts(92,54): error TS7006: Parameter 'e' implicitly has an 'any' type.
aspose_cells/workbook.ts(482,63): error TS2345: Argument of type 'Buffer<ArrayBufferLike>' is not assignable to parameter of type 'string'.
```
(exit code 2)

## Where in the repository

- `aspose_cells/chartLoader.ts:210` and `:236`; `aspose_cells/util.ts:74-77` (`readZipEntry` returns `string | null`)
- `aspose_cells/workbook.ts:482`; `aspose_cells/types.ts:406` (`ImageInfo.data` is a `Buffer`); `aspose_cells/util.ts:185` (`addZipEntry(content: string)`)
- `aspose_cells/html/htmlDocument.ts:90,92` (`require('adm-zip')`; `@types/adm-zip` is not in devDependencies)
`npm start` runs through `tsx`, which does not type-check, so runtime use is not affected by this.

## Evidence

- `README.md`: lines 329-334: npm install, npx tsc --noEmit (revision fc186507e5b7124f4664aa6035f25cfd3112367d)
- `docker node:22: npm install && npx tsc --noEmit`: 2026-10-09T21:30Z: 3 errors (chartLoader.ts(210,11) TS2345; html/htmlDocument.ts(92,54) TS7006; workbook.ts(482,63) TS2345); exit 2
- `package.json`: line 17 region: no build script declared; typescript ^5.9.3 resolved to 5.9.3
